lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like pattern of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns with three to four spots per column along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a lattice-like appearance where spots are situated within the lighter vertical regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent linear ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank; the most dorsal ridge exhibits a sharp pixel gradient with light-colored upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 small, high-intensity white spots.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin exhibits a distinct irregular notch or indentation near its apex.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, elongated teleost (remora) is visible swimming beneath the ventral-posterior flank, and a human diver is visible in the distant background above the shark's head.
